od_010_position: OD-010 is RATIFIED and its Ratified Behavior ends with an exact sentence that governs this slice: `No Recommendation or Priority Decision publishes from an unavailable calculation.` Read together with the approved consequence that `the numeric score therefore remains unavailable` at the baseline, and with WF-008's Failure Path requirement to `suppress origin-Issue Recommendations` and set `recommendation_suppression_required=true` on every unavailable calculation, the baseline outcome is determinate: at the ratified baseline NO Recommendation Artifact publishes, because no complete or partial ScoreSnapshot ever promotes. THIS IS SETTLED BASELINE BEHAVIOUR, NOT A WITHHELD LIMB -- exactly parallel to the unavailable numeric score, and phrased the same way. It is not a gap, an interim, or a decision to be reopened. S-14 nevertheless contracts the complete generation, versioning, family and publication machinery, for three reasons Volume I makes explicit: (1) drafts remain reachable -- WF-009's second Trigger is `Issue eligibility changes`, the deterministic Definitions `CHK-TI-001`, `CHK-CQ-001` and `CHK-TR-001` still produce `failed` Results and therefore Issues, and WF-009's Alternate Path states `A withheld Issue may have a draft but cannot publish`; (2) an approved Measurement Set later activates as exact signed configuration, at which point promotion and publication become reachable with no change to this contract; (3) the suppression path is only correct if the publication path it suppresses is fully specified. Nothing in S-14 is withheld.
od_010_ai_position: OD-010's provider limb is also RATIFIED and also settled. No signed `ai-response-interim-v1` or `ai-safety-interim-v1` provider artifact is bundled while provider, model and data-handling selection remains unapproved, so the deterministic interim behaviour is `deterministic_template` generation from the exact catalog templates, and an `ai_assisted` request fails BEFORE entitlement reservation or provider call as `F1-AI-422 / ai_provider_unapproved`, creating no AIResponse and no Citation. That gate is S-10's MTX-012 limb and is consumed here, not restated as a second authority. S-14's obligation is that the `ai_assisted` ARTIFACT path is fully contracted -- one validated unexpired AIResponse per exact Recommendation version, complete verified Citation coverage, binding at publication -- because AC-CAP-016 and AC-PRULE-026 require those fixtures and because the gate closing today does not make the contract optional. An implementation MUST NOT choose a provider, send Evidence, or silently weaken the gate.
od_009_position: OD-009 is RATIFIED (Option 2). Disputed and review-required Issues are excluded from published scoring and prioritisation until eligible. For this slice the consequence is precise: the ORIGIN Issue alone governs eligibility, suppression, priority and lifecycle, so an origin Issue excluded under OD-009 blocks publication and suppresses an already-published Artifact. The eligibility predicate itself is S-12's MTX-048 and is consumed here.
od_007_position: OD-007 is RATIFIED; the one-directional Citation contract is the approved baseline and MUST NOT be described as an interim. A Citation belongs to exactly one AIResponse and points to exactly one Evidence record; neither stores a direct Evaluation link, and evaluation traversal is `AIResponse -> Recommendation Artifact -> origin Issue -> Check Result/Evidence`. The Recommendation Artifact is the LOAD-BEARING MIDDLE LINK of that traversal, which is why this slice's `origin_issue_id` cardinality of exactly one is a structural property of OD-007 rather than a local field rule. A read-model projection MAY denormalize the traversal but MUST NOT become write authority.
ownership_split_with_s_10: The `Workflows::Wf009::` namespace is SHARED. S-10 owns the AIResponse and Citation commands -- `RequestAiResponse`, `PersistGeneratedPayload`, `ProposeCitations`, `ValidateAiResponse`, `RejectAiResponse`, `ExpireAiResponse`, `SupersedeCitations` -- and S-14 ADDS ONLY the Artifact commands. Neither redefines the other's. S-10's contract states this from its side: `Recommendation Artifact generation, versioning and publication are WF-009 commands owned by S-14`. PRULE-015's CAP-016 limb -- the prohibited-advisory-domain scanner binding the DETERMINISTIC template output as well as generated output -- is MTX-066's and is linked, not re-contracted.

MTX-034.interface_type: System automation plus one authorized principal limb. WF-009's Actors is `System automation`; its Authorization is `Generation service identity; deterministic auto-publication service or OrganizationAdmin/MarketingOperator holding recommendation.publish. TechnicalImplementer is a consumer and cannot publish.` Generation, validation and versioning have no principal-reachable command; publication is reachable either by the deterministic auto-publication service when policy permits or by a principal holding `recommendation.publish`.
MTX-034.route: Not applicable - Volume I defines the two triggers, the actors, the exact permission and the record contracts but no HTTP path, method or transport. Both triggers are internal: a complete or partial ScoreSnapshot is promoted, or Issue eligibility changes. Neither is an inbound request or callback. Transport exposure is owned by API_CONTRACTS.md at the Volume II baseline; reading a produced Artifact is `recommendation.read` and is CAP-018's surface.
MTX-034.request_schema: Generation takes no request; it consumes the frozen generation input named in WF-009 Preconditions -- the atomic Issue set with its current pointer and every referenced Issue `state_version` matching, exactly one current origin Issue per candidate, citation-ready Evidence in that Issue or Check lineage, a Check Definition resolving an exact Recommendation template, active `effort-interim-v1` or approved replacement, and the known family and current-projection version. Publication: Artifact ID, family ID, expected family projection state version, expected origin Issue state version, and the command idempotency key.
MTX-034.response_schema: One linear family of draft, published, suppressed or retired immutable Artifact versions linked to one origin Issue, optional non-governing related Issues, valid Evidence, and at most one current published or suppressed pointer, per CAP-016 Outputs. Each Artifact carries its complete required attribute set. A publication returns the updated Current Recommendation Family Projection with its new state version.
MTX-034.controller: Not applicable - no HTTP adapter is defined by Volume I; see route.
MTX-034.command: `Workflows::Wf009::GenerateRecommendationArtifact`, `Workflows::Wf009::ValidateRecommendationArtifact`, `Workflows::Wf009::PublishRecommendationArtifact`, `Workflows::Wf009::SuppressRecommendationArtifact`, `Workflows::Wf009::RepublishRecommendationArtifact`, `Workflows::Wf009::RetireRecommendationArtifact`. The `Workflows::Wf009::` namespace is SHARED with S-10, which owns `RequestAiResponse`, `PersistGeneratedPayload`, `ProposeCitations`, `ValidateAiResponse`, `RejectAiResponse`, `ExpireAiResponse` and `SupersedeCitations`. S-14 adds only the six Artifact commands and redefines none of S-10's.
MTX-034.command_input: Exactly one origin Issue with its `state_version`, impact band, confidence value and band; optional informational `related_issue_references`; the origin Issue's and Check Result's lineage Evidence; the Score Contribution context; the origin Check Definition and outcome code resolving an exact `REC-...-v1` template family at version `1.0.0`; the origin Check Result's normalized observation supplying the template placeholders; the active `effort-interim-v1` version; the family ID and its current projection state version; and the generation service identity. For `ai_assisted`, additionally the validated AIResponse ID.
MTX-034.command_output: A draft Artifact at the next positive family version linked to the prior latest Artifact, or an exact replay returning the stored version; on publication, the prior current published or suppressed version atomically retired, the new version published, the Current Recommendation Family Projection advanced, and the exact version events emitted.
MTX-034.actor: Generation service identity for generation and validation. The deterministic auto-publication service, or an OrganizationAdmin or MarketingOperator holding `recommendation.publish`, for publication. TechnicalImplementer is a CONSUMER and cannot publish. No other actor may create, publish, suppress, republish or retire an Artifact.
MTX-034.organization_scope: The origin Issue's Organization and Project. The origin Issue, every rationale Evidence reference, every related Issue reference, the AIResponse and every Citation resolve inside it; a related Issue reference is expressly a same-Organization reference only.
MTX-034.aggregate: RecommendationArtifact as an immutable per-version root; RecommendationFamily as its linear version sequence; CurrentRecommendationFamilyProjection as the single mutable per-family projection. Issue, CheckResult, Evidence, AIResponse and Citation are read-only antecedents owned by S-12, S-09, S-11 and S-10.
MTX-034.aggregate_boundary: One Artifact family exists per `(origin_issue_id, recommendation_kind=remediation)`. The family NEVER crosses an Issue lineage record: a reassessment successor Issue starts a NEW family even when it uses the same template family. Version 1 has a null predecessor; every later version atomically validates and increments the prior latest version by exactly one and points to that prior Artifact. Reusing a version number or creating a branch is prohibited. The projection, the positive version sequence, the predecessor link, the publication transition and the Artifact event commit ATOMICALLY -- one transaction, five effects.
MTX-034.value_objects: RecommendationId, ArtifactFamilyId, ArtifactVersion, PredecessorRecommendationId, GenerationDefinitionFamilyId, GenerationDefinitionVersion, OriginIssueId, RelatedIssueReferences, ProblemStatement, Rationale, ExpectedImpactBand, ConfidenceValue, ConfidenceBand, EffortBand, EffortBasis, EffortPolicyVersion, ImplementationSteps, VerificationSteps, PlatformApplicability, AdvisoryScope, RationaleEvidenceReferences, GenerationMode, AiResponseId, PublicationStatus, LatestArtifactId, CurrentPublishedArtifactId, FamilyProjectionStateVersion.

Template rendering, the `effort-interim-v1` mapping and the `effort_basis` construction are pure functions over the frozen origin Check Result, which is what makes FX-CHECK-COM-013's byte-identical rendering assertion meaningful.
MTX-034.repository: `RecommendationArtifactRepository`, `RecommendationFamilyRepository`, `RecommendationFamilyProjectionRepository`, `RecommendationRelatedIssueRepository`, `RecommendationEvidenceRepository`; `IssueRepository`, `CheckResultRepository`, `EvidenceRepository`, `AiResponseRepository` and `CitationRepository` read-only; `CurrentScoreProjectionRepository` read-only at the publication gate.
MTX-034.persistence_model: `recommendation_families` is unique on `(origin_issue_id, recommendation_kind)` -- that constraint IS the one-family-per-origin rule, so a second family for the same origin is unreachable. `recommendation_artifacts` is unique on `(family_id, artifact_version)` and on the direct predecessor successor, which is what makes a branch and a reused version number unreachable rather than merely tested. `recommendation_related_issues` carries an informational flag FIXED TRUE -- a related Issue cannot be promoted to an origin by flipping a column. `recommendation_evidences` records the Evidence and Decision IDs, digests, statuses and role. Per POSTGRESQL_SCHEMA.md exactly one Artifact family exists per `(origin_issue_id, recommendation_kind)` and one Artifact per positive family version.
MTX-034.migration: Not applicable at this row - the canonical schema already owns `recommendation_families`, `recommendation_artifacts`, `recommendation_related_issues` and `recommendation_evidences` per schemas/POSTGRESQL_SCHEMA.md. No product schema object is added. A nullable or multi-valued `origin_issue_id` MUST NOT be migrated: PRULE-027 requires exactly one origin, and a column permitting zero or many would make the sole-origin rule a runtime check instead of a structural one.
MTX-034.transaction_boundary: Generation: one transaction atomically validating the current family version and creating the next positive version linked to the prior latest Artifact, or returning the stored version on exact replay. Validation: one read-only pass over the frozen input before any publication. Publication: ONE transaction that atomically retires the prior current published or suppressed version when one exists, publishes the new version, advances the Current Recommendation Family Projection, binds the validated AIResponse and cancels its expiry when `ai_assisted`, and emits the exact version events. Creating or failing a draft advances NO current-published pointer.
MTX-034.concurrency: Every Artifact command carries the expected family projection state version and the expected origin Issue state version. Atomic family-version validation is what makes `increments the prior latest version by exactly one` safe: two concurrent generations against the same latest version cannot both commit, and the loser is `artifact_family_version_conflict`. An exact generation-command replay returns the SAME version; changed generation input under the SAME key is `idempotency_conflict`. Volume I expressly leaves the physical concurrency mechanism to Volume II; the observable contract is the linear sequence with no gap and no branch.
MTX-034.idempotency: Generation is keyed by the generation command idempotency key over the frozen generation input. An exact replay returns the same Artifact version and emits no second event. Changed generation input under the same key is `idempotency_conflict`. Publication is idempotent by Artifact ID and the expected family projection version: republishing an already-published current version returns the stored outcome without a second retirement, a second pointer move or a second event. Suppressing an already-suppressed Artifact is a no-op emitting no second event.
MTX-034.background_job: `RecommendationGenerationJob` under the `recommendation_generate` work type, claiming one `work_executions` row per the Job Catalogue durable idempotency authority. The WF-009 stage is the `refresh_recommendations_and_priority` stage of `evaluation_stage_checkpoints`, the ninth and last ordinal; a succeeded ordinal creates the unique next-stage Scheduled Action and is the only authority to continue. No Domain Event is a stage dispatcher.
MTX-034.queue: The evaluation queue, per the Volume I Background Processing action registry. Queue identity is owned by BACKGROUND_PROCESSING.md; this row does not rename it.
MTX-034.retry_policy: No retry belongs to WF-009's Artifact limb. Its Recovery Path is explicit: correct the named governed input and create a NEW LINKED Artifact version, or a new AIResponse attempt. An unchanged suppressed current version may republish ONLY after origin eligibility and every validation predicate pass again. A retired version NEVER reopens. A failed draft remains history and cannot displace the current-published pointer. Provider and validation retry create a new AIResponse attempt linked by causation ID and are S-10's limb; no hidden provider retry is allowed.
MTX-034.terminal_failure: WF-009's Failure Path publishes NOTHING and NEVER displaces the current version. The nine reasons apply in this exact FIRST-MATCH order: `recommendation_template_unavailable`, `effort_policy_unavailable`, `recommendation_template_input_invalid`, `recommendation_schema_invalid`, `prohibited_advisory_domain`, `origin_evidence_invalid`, `origin_ineligible`, `stale_origin_version`, `artifact_family_version_conflict`. Created AIResponse and Citation decisions remain IMMUTABLE through a failure. `retired` is terminal for an Artifact.
MTX-034.reconciliation: The Artifact state machine is exhaustive: `Draft -> Published, Suppressed or Retired`; `Published -> Suppressed or Retired`; `Suppressed -> Published or Retired`; `Retired` is terminal. Publishing atomically retires the prior current published or suppressed version when present, advances the current-published pointer, and leaves every earlier payload immutable. Creating a draft advances ONLY the latest pointer. Suppression changes the pointed version to suppressed but does NOT clear the pointer; valid republication changes that same version back to published. AIResponse and Citation transitions are exactly those in `citation-policy-v1` and are S-10's.
MTX-034.domain_events: `RecommendationArtifactGenerated`, `RecommendationPublished`, `RecommendationSuppressed`, `RecommendationRetired`. This row is the sole producer of those four. `AIResponseRequested`, `AIResponseGenerated`, `AIResponseValidated`, `AIResponseRejected`, `AIResponseExpired`, `CitationProposed`, `CitationVerified`, `CitationInvalidated`, `CitationSuperseded`, `AIResponseFingerprintCollision` and `CitationFingerprintCollision` are listed in WF-009's Domain Events and are produced on S-10's AI limb; this row consumes them and re-emits none. `ComparisonGenerated` and `ReassessmentTriggered` are REMOVED under ratified OD-024 and OD-025 and are asserted absent.
MTX-034.event_payload: The canonical envelope with the real `organization_id`, plus `project_id`, `recommendation_id`, `artifact_family_id`, `artifact_version`, `predecessor_recommendation_id`, `origin_issue_id` and its state version, the ordered `related_issue_references` marked informational, `generation_definition_family_id` and `generation_definition_version`, `generation_mode`, nullable `ai_response_id`, `effort_band`, `effort_basis`, `effort_policy_version`, `platform_applicability`, `advisory_scope`, `publication_status`, and the family projection state version. `RecommendationPublished` additionally carries the retired prior version identity and the prior and resulting current-published pointer. `RecommendationSuppressed` carries the triggering Issue or Evidence Decision identity and the suppression reason.
MTX-034.event_producer: `Workflows::Wf009` under the generation service identity for generation, and under the deterministic auto-publication service or the authorized principal for publication. Queue depth, worker scheduling, lease acquisition and provider timing internals are technical telemetry and MUST NOT be emitted as domain events.
MTX-034.event_consumers: S-15 consumes `RecommendationPublished` as the WF-010 trigger -- WF-010's Trigger is `Recommendation publication completed`. S-16 consumes the Current Recommendation Family Projection for Recommendation status on dashboard reads. Volume I names NO baseline notification route for any of the four Artifact events; one MUST NOT be invented.
MTX-034.serializer: Not applicable - no transport exposure is defined by Volume I for generation or publication; see route. Artifact read serialization is `recommendation.read` and is bound by the Score Visibility And Redaction matrix's `recommendation.rationale` and `recommendation.steps` field groups, which is CAP-018's surface.
MTX-034.authorization_entry_point: The generation service identity at each generation and validation command. The publication command, BEFORE mutation, with both the expected family projection state version and the expected origin Issue state version -- so an authorization result is never carried across a version boundary, and an origin Issue that becomes ineligible between authorization and commit is caught as `stale_origin_version` or `origin_ineligible` rather than published.
MTX-034.permission_checks: `recommendation.publish` for publication, republication, suppression and retirement: the Permission Baseline ALLOWS it for OrganizationAdmin and MarketingOperator, and DENIES it for TechnicalImplementer, SecurityOperator, BillingOperator and the Read-Only Executive Buyer; its service cell reads `deterministic publication service only when policy permits`, which is a conditional grant and not an unconditional one. WF-009 states expressly that TechnicalImplementer is a consumer and CANNOT publish, even though CAP-016 names it as an actor -- the actor list is a consumer role, not a publication grant. `recommendation.read` governs reading a produced Artifact and is CAP-018's entry point. There is NO principal permission for Artifact generation or validation and none may be invented.
MTX-034.tenant_boundary: Every link resolves inside the origin Issue's Organization: the origin Issue, its rationale Evidence, each related Issue reference, the AIResponse's input Evidence tuples and each Citation's Evidence. PRULE-027 requires exactly one SAME-ORGANIZATION origin Issue. A related Issue reference is expressly a same-Organization informational reference and cannot supply required Evidence.
MTX-034.error_contract: The nine WF-009 first-match failure reasons, exhaustive: `recommendation_template_unavailable`, `effort_policy_unavailable`, `recommendation_template_input_invalid`, `recommendation_schema_invalid`, `prohibited_advisory_domain`, `origin_evidence_invalid`, `origin_ineligible`, `stale_origin_version`, `artifact_family_version_conflict`. Plus `idempotency_conflict` for changed generation input under a reused key. `prohibited_advisory_domain` fails NONRETRYABLY. An unlisted failed outcome under `effort-interim-v1` is `effort_policy_unavailable` and blocks Recommendation publication AND Priority Decision creation WITHOUT changing the Issue or the score. `F1-AI-422 / ai_provider_unapproved` is S-10's gate reason and is consumed here.
MTX-034.audit_record: Per WF-009 Audit and Observability: the family, current, predecessor and version identities; the origin and related Issue DISTINCTION; the Check, outcome, template and effort resolution; the generation mode; the response and Citation fingerprints and replay outcomes; the prompt, model and policy versions; every claim and Citation decision; expiry and binding; the publication replacement and retirement; and the validation outcome.
MTX-034.observability: `RecommendationArtifactGenerated` on every draft, `RecommendationPublished` on every publication carrying the retired prior version and the pointer move, `RecommendationSuppressed` per suppressed Artifact carrying its trigger, `RecommendationRetired` on every retirement. Because suppression emits per Artifact, the count of Artifacts suppressed by one invalidation is observable rather than inferred.
MTX-034.retention: Artifact versions and lineage are persisted per CAP-016 Data Implications: every version's payload, its predecessor link, its origin and related Issue references, its Evidence references and its publication history are immutable `product_history` and never mutate. An authorized correction creates a NEW version and never rewrites an earlier one. The window is owned by 015 DATA_LIFECYCLE.md; this row states none.

MTX-016.interface_type: Capability-level obligation discharged by the WF-009 contract plus the Recommendation Artifact and Current Recommendation Family Projection record contracts. CAP-016 defines no interface of its own; its publication actors reach it through the WF-009 publication command.
MTX-016.route: Not applicable - CAP-016 defines no interface independent of WF-009; see MTX-034.
MTX-016.request_schema: Per CAP-016 Inputs: exactly one origin Issue, optional informational related Issue references, origin-lineage Evidence, Score Contribution context, and artifact templates or a validated AIResponse.
MTX-016.response_schema: Per CAP-016 Outputs: one linear family of draft, published, suppressed or retired immutable Artifact versions linked to ONE origin Issue, optional NON-GOVERNING related Issues, valid Evidence, and AT MOST ONE current published or suppressed pointer.
MTX-016.controller: Not applicable - no HTTP adapter is defined by Volume I.
MTX-016.command: As MTX-034 - the six `Workflows::Wf009::` Artifact commands. CAP-016 adds no command of its own.
MTX-016.actor: Recommendation service for generation; OrganizationAdmin or MarketingOperator for publication; TechnicalImplementer as CONSUMER, per CAP-016 Actor. The Actor line naming TechnicalImplementer is a consumer role and is expressly not a publication grant -- WF-009's Authorization says so and the Permission Baseline denies `recommendation.publish` to that role.
MTX-016.organization_scope: The origin Issue's Organization and Project. CAP-016 Preconditions require CAP-014 and CAP-015 COMPLETE -- the Issue exists and adjudication has resolved, and a score calculation has run. Note that CAP-015 complete does NOT mean the score is available: an unavailable calculation is a completed CAP-015 outcome, and at the OD-010 baseline it is the only one.
MTX-016.aggregate: RecommendationArtifact, RecommendationFamily and CurrentRecommendationFamilyProjection -- the three records this slice owns.
